primary_claims.locator: Results p0195/p0205, Fig 7; p0210 and Discussion p0230
primary_claims.claim: Intestine-specific Acsl5 deletion in male mice increased postprandial circulating GLP-1/PYY. Authors propose altered enterocyte fatty-acid trapping and increased mucosal NEFA as an enteroendocrine stimulus.
primary_claims.role: Already published ACSL5-secretion relationship; not generic secretory-pathway validation, not PMP22, not a quantitative reanalysis here.

primary_claims.claim: ACSL5 knockdown in rat primary hepatocytes reduced radiolabeled TAG appearance in media, reported approximately 50%, alongside lower cellular TAG synthesis.
primary_claims.role: Endpoint/context counterexample to blanket secretion enhancement. Lipid export is not secreted protein and this does not falsify the frozen protein-cargo prediction. Source-text observation, not newly digitized/quantified values.

primary_claims.locator: S4 complete selected HRP follow-up; S6 Golgi images
primary_claims.claim: Raw HRP measurements including ACSL5 were already published. GPR161/TMEM220 mechanistic follow-up was reported; our reanalysis separates absolute reporter activity, within-cell reporter activity and their ratio across individual repeats.
primary_claims.role: Potentially overlooked assay-level reclassification, not new measurements or verified mechanism.

validation.ncb2510: Candidate independent human cargo RNAi screen; native outcomes/target coverage unavailable after publisher Client Challenge, structured metadata and repository searches, DNS/403 supplement probes. Not evaluated.
validation.PMC6754299: Additional VCP/PGD disposition study was acquired as primary HTML; exact native secretome/whole-proteome workbook downloads blocked by HTML preparation pages and alternate-source errors. No numerical results produced.
validation.same_study_orthogonal: Golgi phenotype in HRP study and KCNQ1 electrophysiology in JCI are orthogonal readouts but not independent replication of the HRP ACSL5 claim; culture nesting/count discrepancies retained.
validation.computational_verification: Separately implemented checks verify outputs against native scalar values and local controls. These verify computations, not biological reproducibility.

conclusion: No verified novel PMP22 mechanism. Previously published assays support a new endpoint/replicate sensitivity analysis and an ACSL5 cargo hypothesis; targeted absence of abstracts is not proof of novelty.
